agree.label: Re 40, spin: 3D agrees with 2D
agree.description: Spinning cylinder, periodic span, below the onset of 3D flow. Measured (LBM, this grid): the small spanwise seed decays (σ ≈ −0.30 between t = 20 and 60), so the 3D run stays spanwise-uniform and matches the 2D baseline. On this grid the onset lies between Re 40 and Re 50 (σ ≈ +0.014 at Re 50).

transition.label: Re 100, spin: the seed grows
transition.description: Spinning cylinder, periodic span. Measured (LBM, this grid): the spanwise perturbation grows (σ ≈ 0.61) and the 3D enstrophy departs from the 2D baseline by more than 5 % at t ≈ 8.6; over t = 10–20 the 3D enstrophy is 2.6 times the 2D value and the torque 1.17 times.

turbulent.label: Re 800, spin + orbit: strongly 3D
turbulent.description: Spinning and orbiting cylinder, periodic span. Measured (LBM, this grid): the perturbation grows fast (σ ≈ 1.7), 27 % of the kinetic energy varies along the span over t = 10–20, shared by the spanwise modes k_z = 1, 2, 3, 4 in falling amounts (0.032, 0.0096, 0.0039, 0.0016), and the 3D enstrophy is 3.5 times the 2D value. The torque, averaged over t = 10–20, is about 5 times the 2D value.

ekman.label: Re 200, spin, end walls: Ekman layers
ekman.description: Spinning cylinder between stationary end walls. Measured (LBM, this grid): the flow is three-dimensional from the start (spanwise velocity appears at once, no growth phase); over t = 10–20 the 3D enstrophy is 5.9 times and the torque 3.1 times the 2D baseline, and the kinetic energy is about half of it.
